---
title: "WA economic indicators"
subtitle: "Labour market, inflation and residential construction"
---

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(glue)
library(htmltools)
library(jsonlite)

summary_data <- read_csv("data/dashboard_summary.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
labour <- read_csv("data/labour_market.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
cpi <- read_csv("data/cpi_capital_cities.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
dwellings <- read_csv("data/dwelling_approvals.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
metadata <- fromJSON("data/metadata.json")

parse_values <- function(x) as.numeric(strsplit(x, "\\|")[[1]])

spark_svg <- function(values, colour, width = 150, height = 46) {
  x <- seq(4, width - 4, length.out = length(values))
  rng <- range(values, na.rm = TRUE)
  y <- if (diff(rng) == 0) rep(height / 2, length(values)) else
    4 + (max(values) - values) / diff(rng) * (height - 8)

  points <- paste(sprintf("%.1f,%.1f", x, y), collapse = " ")
  last_x <- sprintf("%.1f", tail(x, 1))
  last_y <- sprintf("%.1f", tail(y, 1))

  glue(
    '<svg class="sparkline" viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" role="img" aria-label="Recent trend">',
    '<polyline points="{points}" fill="none" stroke="{colour}" stroke-width="3" ',
    'stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>',
    '<circle cx="{last_x}" cy="{last_y}" r="4" fill="white" ',
    'stroke="{colour}" stroke-width="3"/></svg>'
  )
}

status_class <- function(x) paste0("cell-", x)

dashboard_row <- function(indicator, group, latest_display, month_display,
                          year_display, base_display, latest_status,
                          month_status, year_status, base_status,
                          spark_values, spark_colour, note) {
  glue(
    '<div class="summary-row">',
      '<div class="indicator-cell"><span class="section-kicker">{htmlEscape(group)}</span>',
      '<strong>{htmlEscape(indicator)}</strong><small>{htmlEscape(note)}</small></div>',
      '<div class="trend-cell">{spark_svg(parse_values(spark_values), spark_colour)}</div>',
      '<div class="metric-cell latest-cell {status_class(latest_status)}">{htmlEscape(latest_display)}</div>',
      '<div class="metric-cell {status_class(month_status)}">{htmlEscape(month_display)}</div>',
      '<div class="metric-cell {status_class(year_status)}">{htmlEscape(year_display)}</div>',
      '<div class="metric-cell {status_class(base_status)}">{htmlEscape(base_display)}</div>',
    '</div>'
  )
}

rows <- pmap_chr(summary_data, dashboard_row)

make_table <- function(data, highlight_name = NULL, highlight_row = NULL) {
  headers <- paste0("<th>", htmlEscape(names(data)), "</th>", collapse = "")
  body <- map_chr(seq_len(nrow(data)), function(i) {
    cells <- map_chr(seq_along(data), function(j) {
      classes <- character()
      if (j == 1) classes <- c(classes, "row-label")
      if (!is.null(highlight_name) && names(data)[j] == highlight_name)
        classes <- c(classes, "highlight-column")
      if (!is.null(highlight_row) && i == highlight_row)
        classes <- c(classes, "highlight-row")
      class <- if (length(classes)) paste0(' class="', paste(classes, collapse=" "), '"') else ""
      glue("<td{class}>{htmlEscape(as.character(data[[j]][i]))}</td>")
    })
    glue("<tr>{paste(cells, collapse='')}</tr>")
  })

  glue('<div class="table-wrap"><table class="data-table"><thead><tr>{headers}</tr></thead>',
       '<tbody>{paste(body, collapse="")}</tbody></table></div>')
}
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
cat(glue(
  '<div class="snapshot">Updated {metadata$updated_at}</div>',
  '<section class="card summary-scroll">',
  '<div class="summary-header"><div></div>',
  '<div>Recent trend<small>Last 3 years</small></div>',
  '<div>Latest figure<small>Latest release</small></div>',
  '<div>One month change<small>Previous month</small></div>',
  '<div>One year change<small>Previous year</small></div>',
  '<div>Change since COVID-19<small>March 2020</small></div></div>',
  paste(rows, collapse = ""),
  '</section>'
))
```

## Labour market details

```{r}
#| results: asis
cat(make_table(labour, highlight_name = "Western Australia",
               highlight_row = which(labour[[1]] == "Unemployment rate")))
```

## CPI details

```{r}
#| results: asis
cat(make_table(cpi, highlight_name = "Perth",
               highlight_row = which(cpi[[1]] == "All groups")))
```

## Dwelling approvals details

```{r}
#| results: asis
cat(make_table(dwellings,
               highlight_row = which(dwellings[[1]] == "Western Australia")))
```
